querySql:
select 
                                      object_id,
                                      trade_dt,
                                      windcode,
                                      term_variety,
                                      last_cp_net,
                                      last_wp_net,
                                      op_net,
                                      np_new,
                                      np_high,
                                      np_low,
                                      cp_net,
                                      wp_net,
                                      nominal_amount,
                                      return_lc,
                                      return_lw,
                                      return_open,
                                      return_new,
                                      return_high,
                                      return_low,
                                      return_close,
                                      return_weight,
                                      chg,
                                      opdate,
                                      opmode,
                                      to_char(sysdate - 1, 'yyyymmdd') as bath_dt,
                                      cast(sysdate as timestamp) as data_ins_time,
                                      'w_cbondforwardmarketn.json' as task_rs_id
                                from ${srcoradbname}.cbondforwardmarketn WHERE trade_dt BETWEEN '${busi_month}'||'01' AND to_char(add_months(to_date('${busi_month}'||'01','yyyyMMdd'),1)-1,'yyyyMMdd')
